data.one_liner: On-device speech-to-text for Flutter powered by whisper.cpp
data.what_it_does: Provides on-device automatic speech recognition (ASR) using Whisper models via whisper.cpp. Supports both one-off audio file transcription and live streaming transcription with optional VAD and speaker-turn detection.
use_when: You need completely offline speech-to-text without cloud APIs or keys.
You want live streaming speech transcription in a Flutter app.
You need voice activity detection (VAD) or basic speaker diarization.
avoid_when: You require cloud-based speech recognition services with massive pre-trained language vocabularies.
You cannot accept the app bundle size increase from including or downloading Whisper model weights.
strengths: Fully offline, local execution with no server dependency.
Supports live streaming transcription with partial results.
Fast native performance utilizing whisper.cpp with hardware acceleration.
weaknesses: Requires managing large model files (from tens of megabytes to gigabytes).
Platform configuration required for native builds and minimum OS targets (e.g. iOS 15.6).
data.setup_notes: Requires setting the iOS deployment target to 15.6 or later in Podfile and Xcode. On Windows and Linux, FFmpeg must be installed on PATH if non-WAV audio files are processed.
